About.title: Area under protection. Beware: angry horns.
text: Hey! If you're here, it's definitely not by accident.
Like me, you're searching for at least a glimmer of light and warmth in this wretched world.
And you've found it — in the profound lyrics of Cannibal Corpse and the cozy atmosphere of Burzum.
So don't be afraid, come on in. It's going to be fun.
Join the conversation with like-minded people!
